edits.new:
The operating values — the business time zone, the catch-up window, the replica counts, the resource limits, the threshold of a held snapshot and the alert rates — are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-2207; ASM-3623). The chart exposes every value and this story ships no environment-specific default. The values are set per environment in the rwb-case values files; the business time zone and the catch-up window are confirmed with the business owner and the platform team at the SIT dry run and recorded in the runbook section that each alert links (GAP-2207).

JOB-06, and every other job in the map, runs as a Temporal Schedule in the owning service (RWB-PLT-E1071-CON); the Quartz note RWB-TE-007 is retired and kept for traceability only (GAP-3166).

edits.new:
Then no file, data-lake copy or lake path resource appears in the release

  Scenario: AC9 A redelivered TimerBreached event changes a case only once (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the consumer of rwb.case.TimerBreached.v1 on rwb.case.events.v1 in its consumer group
    When the same event is delivered a second time
    Then the second delivery changes no case and is recorded as a duplicate, not processed again

  Scenario: AC10 A status change the model does not allow is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the status model of the api operations in section 12
    When a status change the model does not allow is sent through an api operation
    Then the api refuses the change and no case or queue state is altered

  Scenario: AC11 Every business rule of section 8 has a criterion and a test (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the business rules BR1 to BR9 of section 8
    When the criteria of section 7 and the test cases of section 16 are compared with the rules
    Then every rule has at least one criterion and one test case row, and the covering IDs in section 8 match them
